reranker.scoring: raw single classification logit; no sigmoid
reranker.truncation: only_second; reject query with no passage token budget

limitations: Exact offsets do not establish semantic correctness or complete relevance labels.
Negative/ambiguous labels require human assessment of the entire indexed scope.
AI question authoring is not reproducible inference; committed labels and prompt hashes are replayable.

protocol.document_presence: Only documents of globally full-span-representable alternatives determine absent versus other-chunks categories; all alternative document presence also reported.
protocol.alternatives: grade2 spans OR within group; groups AND; whole span in one chunk
protocol.occupancy: Exact same-document offset intersections and manifest family membership only; not semantic duplicates or redundant facts.

tokenizer_visibility.definition: Strict union of source-codepoint token offsets covers the entire annotated interval in one source chunk. Whitespace/normalization gaps are not filled. Separate retention of all overlapping pre-truncation tokens does not assert literal source coverage or semantic understanding. Special/query/prefix tokens excluded; no decode or max-offset envelope.

limitations: AI labels unreviewed and non-exhaustive; no human review or answer-quality evidence.
Diagnostics associate candidate/offset properties with failures; they do not establish causes.
No new retrieval ranking, model quality, Java service performance, or ACL measurement.
Group reasons are disjoint; question flags overlap and must not be summed as question counts.
